question: A six-digit number has all its digits equal (like 444,444). Such a number is always divisible by:
solution: aaaaaa = a × 111,111 and 111,111 = 111 × 1,001, so every such number is divisible by 1,001. 111,111 itself is not divisible by 999 (= 27 × 37), 1,111 (= 11 × 101) or 101.

subject: Maths
question: What is the smallest natural number n for which n! is divisible by 990?
solution: 990 = 2 × 3² × 5 × 11. The factor 11 first appears in 11!, and 11! already has 2, 3² and 5. So n = 11 (10! has no 11).
questionHi: वह सबसे छोटी प्राकृत संख्या n कौन-सी है जिसके लिए n!, 990 से विभाज्य है?

subject: Maths
question: For every odd natural number n, n⁴ + 4n² + 11 is divisible by:
solution: For odd n, n² leaves 1 on division by 8, so n² = 8k + 1. Then n⁴ + 4n² + 11 = (n² + 2)² + 7 = (8k + 3)² + 7 = 64k² + 48k + 16, a multiple of 16. n = 1 gives 16 itself, so 32, 24 and 12 do not.
questionHi: प्रत्येक विषम प्राकृत संख्या n के लिए n⁴ + 4n² + 11 किससे विभाज्य है?
solutionHi: विषम n के लिए n² का 8 से शेष 1, अतः n² = 8k + 1। तब n⁴ + 4n² + 11 = (n² + 2)² + 7 = (8k + 3)² + 7 = 64k² + 48k + 16, 16 का गुणज। n = 1 पर 16 ही, अतः 32, 24 और 12 नहीं।

question: If 2ᵃ × 3ᵇ divides 12!, what is the largest possible value of a + b?
solution: Factors of 2 in 12!: 6 + 3 + 1 = 10. Factors of 3: 4 + 1 = 5. So a can be at most 10 and b at most 5: a + b = 15.
questionHi: यदि 2ᵃ × 3ᵇ, 12! को विभाजित करता है, तो a + b का अधिकतम संभव मान क्या है?

question: How many numbers from 1 to 100 are divisible by the square of some prime (4, 9, 25, 49, ...)?
solution: Multiples of 4: 25, of 9: 11, of 25: 4, of 49: 2. Counted twice: multiples of 36 (2) and of 100 (1). 25 + 11 + 4 + 2 − 2 − 1 = 39.
questionHi: 1 से 100 तक कितनी संख्याएँ किसी अभाज्य के वर्ग (4, 9, 25, 49, ...) से विभाज्य हैं?

subject: Maths
question: The number 123...n is formed by writing 1, 2, 3, ..., n one after another (for n = 12 it is 123456789101112). For how many n from 1 to 50 is it divisible by 9?
solution: A number and its digit sum leave the same remainder on division by 9, so the long number leaves the same remainder as 1 + 2 + ... + n = n(n + 1)/2. That is a multiple of 9 when n leaves 0 or 8 on division by 9: n = 8, 9, 17, 18, 26, 27, 35, 36, 44, 45. That is 10 values.
questionHi: 1, 2, 3, ..., n को एक के बाद एक लिखकर संख्या 123...n बनती है (n = 12 के लिए 123456789101112)। 1 से 50 तक कितने n के लिए यह 9 से विभाज्य है?
solutionHi: किसी संख्या और उसके अंकों के योग का 9 से शेष समान होता है, अतः लंबी संख्या का शेष 1 + 2 + ... + n = n(n + 1)/2 जैसा। यह 9 का गुणज तब जब n का 9 से शेष 0 या 8: n = 8, 9, 17, 18, 26, 27, 35, 36, 44, 45। कुल 10 मान।

subject: Maths
question: What is the largest number that always divides the sum of the cubes of any three consecutive natural numbers?
solution: n³ + (n + 1)³ + (n + 2)³ = 3n³ + 9n² + 15n + 9 = 3(n³ + 5n) + 9n² + 9, and n³ + 5n is always divisible by 3 (it is n³ − n + 6n). So the sum is a multiple of 9. 1 + 8 + 27 = 36 and 8 + 27 + 64 = 99 have HCF 9, so nothing larger always divides it.
questionHi: किन्हीं तीन क्रमागत प्राकृत संख्याओं के घनों के योग को सदा विभाजित करने वाली सबसे बड़ी संख्या कौन-सी है?
solutionHi: n³ + (n + 1)³ + (n + 2)³ = 3n³ + 9n² + 15n + 9 = 3(n³ + 5n) + 9n² + 9, और n³ + 5n सदा 3 से विभाज्य (यह n³ − n + 6n है)। अतः योग 9 का गुणज। 1 + 8 + 27 = 36 और 8 + 27 + 64 = 99 का HCF 9, अतः इससे बड़ी कोई सदा नहीं।

subject: Maths
question: Which of the following divides the number written with ninety-one 1s (111...1, 91 digits)?
solution: A number of k ones divides a number of m ones exactly when k divides m (111...1 with m ones is 1...1 (k ones) × 100...0100...01). 91 = 7 × 13, so seven 1s (1,111,111) divides it; 2, 3 and 5 do not divide 91, so 11, 111 and 11,111 do not.
questionHi: इक्यानबे 1 से लिखी संख्या (111...1, 91 अंक) को निम्नलिखित में से कौन विभाजित करता है?
solutionHi: k इकाइयों वाली संख्या m इकाइयों वाली को ठीक तब विभाजित करती है जब k, m को विभाजित करे। 91 = 7 × 13, अतः सात 1 (1,111,111) विभाजित करता है; 2, 3 और 5, 91 को विभाजित नहीं करते, अतः 11, 111 और 11,111 नहीं।

question: How many numbers from 1 to 500 are divisible by 7 but by neither 3 nor 5?
solution: Multiples of 7: 71. Of these, multiples of 21: 23, of 35: 14, of both (of 105): 4. Remove the multiples of 3 or 5: 23 + 14 − 4 = 33. 71 − 33 = 38.

question: What is the smallest four-digit number with all four digits equal that is divisible by 7?
solution: aaaa = a × 1,111 = a × 11 × 101, and neither 11 nor 101 is divisible by 7. So 7 must divide the digit a itself: a = 7, giving 7,777 = 7 × 1,111.
questionHi: समान चारों अंकों वाली चार अंकों की वह सबसे छोटी संख्या कौन-सी है जो 7 से विभाज्य हो?

question: How many three-digit numbers are divisible by 3 but have no digit divisible by 3 (no 0, 3, 6 or 9)?
solution: The allowed digits leave remainder 1 (1, 4, 7) or 2 (2, 5, 8) on division by 3. Three such remainders add to a multiple of 3 only when all are 1 or all are 2. All from {1, 4, 7}: 3³ = 27; all from {2, 5, 8}: 27. Total 54.
questionHi: तीन अंकों की कितनी संख्याएँ 3 से विभाज्य हैं पर उनका कोई अंक 3 से विभाज्य नहीं (कोई 0, 3, 6 या 9 नहीं)?

question: For how many choices of the digits a and b is the four-digit number 5a2b divisible by 77?
solution: The multiples of 77 from 5,000 to 5,999 run 77 × 65 = 5,005 to 77 × 77 = 5,929. Those with 2 in the tens place: 5,621 = 77 × 73 and 5,929 = 77 × 77. So 2 choices (a = 6, b = 1 and a = 9, b = 9).
questionHi: अंकों a और b के कितने चयनों के लिए चार अंकों की संख्या 5a2b, 77 से विभाज्य है?

question: How many zeros does the product 25! × 36! end with?
solution: Each zero needs a 10 = 2 × 5, and the 5s are scarcer. 25! has 5 + 1 = 6 factors of 5 and 36! has 7 + 1 = 8. Together 14, so 14 zeros.

question: What is the largest number that divides n⁷ − n for every natural number n?
solution: n⁷ − n is divisible by 2, 3 and 7 for every n (n⁷ leaves the same remainder as n on division by 7, and n⁷ − n contains n³ − n, which has 2 and 3). So 42 divides it. 2⁷ − 2 = 126 and 3⁷ − 3 = 2,184 have HCF 42, so nothing larger does.
questionHi: वह सबसे बड़ी संख्या कौन-सी है जो प्रत्येक प्राकृत संख्या n के लिए n⁷ − n को विभाजित करती है?
solutionHi: n⁷ − n हर n के लिए 2, 3 और 7 से विभाज्य है (7 से भाग पर n⁷ और n का शेष समान, और n⁷ − n में n³ − n निहित है, जिसमें 2 और 3 हैं)। अतः 42 विभाजित करता है। 2⁷ − 2 = 126 और 3⁷ − 3 = 2,184 का HCF 42, अतः इससे बड़ी कोई नहीं।

question: What is the smallest number greater than 1,000 that is divisible by each of the numbers from 1 to 10?
solution: Such a number is a multiple of the LCM of 1 to 10, which is 2³ × 3² × 5 × 7 = 2,520. 2,520 is already greater than 1,000. (1,260 and 1,680 are not divisible by 8 and 9 respectively.)
questionHi: 1,000 से बड़ी वह सबसे छोटी संख्या कौन-सी है जो 1 से 10 तक की प्रत्येक संख्या से विभाज्य है?

subject: Maths
question: How many three-digit numbers whose digits are all prime (2, 3, 5 or 7, repetition allowed) are divisible by 3?
solution: On division by 3 the digits leave: 3 → 0, 7 → 1, 2 and 5 → 2. The three remainders must add to a multiple of 3: all 0 (333): 1; all 1 (777): 1; all 2 (from 2 and 5): 2³ = 8; one of each: 3! orders × 2 choices for the remainder-2 digit = 12. Total 1 + 1 + 8 + 12 = 22.
questionHi: तीन अंकों की कितनी संख्याएँ, जिनके सभी अंक अभाज्य (2, 3, 5 या 7, दोहराव की अनुमति) हैं, 3 से विभाज्य हैं?

subject: Maths
question: For how many prime numbers p is p² + 8 also a prime number?
solution: If p is not 3, p² leaves 1 on division by 3, so p² + 8 leaves 1 + 8 = 9, i.e. 0: it is a multiple of 3 greater than 3, not prime. Only p = 3 remains, and 3² + 8 = 17 is prime. So exactly 1.
questionHi: कितनी अभाज्य संख्याओं p के लिए p² + 8 भी अभाज्य संख्या है?
solutionHi: यदि p, 3 नहीं है, तो p² का 3 से शेष 1, अतः p² + 8 का शेष 1 + 8 = 9, यानी 0: यह 3 से बड़ा 3 का गुणज है, अभाज्य नहीं। केवल p = 3 बचता है, और 3² + 8 = 17 अभाज्य है। अतः ठीक 1।

question: What is the smallest multiple of 13 greater than 13 whose last two digits are 13?
solution: The number is 100k + 13. It is divisible by 13 when 100k is, and 100 is not a multiple of 13, so k must be: k = 13 gives 1,313 = 13 × 101.
questionHi: 13 से बड़ा 13 का वह सबसे छोटा गुणज कौन-सा है जिसके अंतिम दो अंक 13 हों?

question: For every natural number n, 2⁶ⁿ − 1 is divisible by:
solution: 2⁶ⁿ − 1 = 64ⁿ − 1, and aⁿ − 1 is always divisible by a − 1 = 63. n = 1 gives 63 itself, so 127, 65 and 31 do not always divide it.
questionHi: प्रत्येक प्राकृत संख्या n के लिए 2⁶ⁿ − 1 किससे विभाज्य है?
solutionHi: 2⁶ⁿ − 1 = 64ⁿ − 1, और aⁿ − 1 सदा a − 1 = 63 से विभाज्य है। n = 1 पर 63 ही, अतः 127, 65 और 31 सदा नहीं।

question: How many numbers from 1 to 1,000 are divisible by 2 or by 5, but not by 10?
solution: Multiples of 2: 500, of 5: 200, of both (of 10): 100. Divisible by exactly one of 2 and 5: (500 − 100) + (200 − 100) = 500.

question: If the five-digit number 98a2b is divisible by 72, what is the largest possible value of a + b?
solution: 72 = 8 × 9. For 9 the digit sum 19 + a + b must be 27 or 36, so a + b = 8 or 17. For 8 the last three digits a2b must be divisible by 8. a + b = 17: a = 9, b = 8 gives 928 = 8 × 116, so 98,928 works. The largest a + b is 17.

question: For every natural number n, 2²ⁿ⁺¹ + 1 is divisible by:
solution: 2 leaves −1 on division by 3, so an odd power of 2 leaves −1 too, and 2²ⁿ⁺¹ + 1 leaves 0. n = 2 gives 33, which is not divisible by 9, 5 or 7.
questionHi: प्रत्येक प्राकृत संख्या n के लिए 2²ⁿ⁺¹ + 1 किससे विभाज्य है?
solutionHi: 3 से भाग पर 2 का शेष −1, अतः 2 की विषम घात का शेष भी −1, और 2²ⁿ⁺¹ + 1 का शेष 0। n = 2 पर 33, जो 9, 5 या 7 से विभाज्य नहीं।

question: Which of 111,111, 1,111,111, 11,111 and 1,111 is divisible by 7?
solution: 111,111 = 111 × 1,001 = 111 × 7 × 11 × 13, so it is divisible by 7. On division by 7, 1,111 leaves 5, 11,111 leaves 2 and 1,111,111 leaves 1.

question: What is the least number that must be subtracted from 10,000 to make it divisible by each of 7, 9 and 11?
solution: Divisible by 7, 9 and 11 means divisible by 7 × 9 × 11 = 693. 693 × 14 = 9,702 and 693 × 15 = 10,395, so subtract 10,000 − 9,702 = 298.

question: How many three-digit numbers have a digit sum that is a multiple of 9?
solution: A number's digit sum is a multiple of 9 exactly when the number is divisible by 9. The three-digit multiples of 9 run from 108 = 9 × 12 to 999 = 9 × 111: 111 − 12 + 1 = 100.

question: For how many natural numbers p are p, p + 2 and p + 4 all prime?
solution: p, p + 2 and p + 4 leave three different remainders on division by 3, so one of them is a multiple of 3. For all three to be prime, that one must be 3 itself: p = 3, giving 3, 5, 7. So exactly 1.
questionHi: कितनी प्राकृत संख्याओं p के लिए p, p + 2 और p + 4 तीनों अभाज्य हैं?

subject: Maths
question: For how many natural numbers n from 1 to 30 is n² + 4 divisible by 5?
solution: n² + 4 is divisible by 5 when n² leaves 1 on division by 5, i.e. when n leaves 1 or 4 (n ends in 1, 4, 6 or 9). From 1 to 30 that is 4 numbers in each ten: 12.
questionHi: 1 से 30 तक कितनी प्राकृत संख्याओं n के लिए n² + 4, 5 से विभाज्य है?
solutionHi: n² + 4, 5 से तब विभाज्य जब n² का 5 से शेष 1, यानी n का शेष 1 या 4 (n का अंतिम अंक 1, 4, 6 या 9)। 1 से 30 में हर दहाई में 4: 12।

subject: Maths
question: How many two-digit numbers are divisible by 3 while the number formed by reversing their digits is not?
solution: Reversing the digits does not change the digit sum, and divisibility by 3 depends only on the digit sum. So a number and its reverse are always both divisible by 3 or both not: 0 such numbers.
questionHi: दो अंकों की कितनी संख्याएँ 3 से विभाज्य हैं जबकि उनके अंक उलटकर बनी संख्या नहीं?
solutionHi: अंक उलटने से अंकों का योग नहीं बदलता, और 3 से विभाज्यता केवल अंकों के योग पर निर्भर है। अतः संख्या और उसकी उलटी दोनों सदा 3 से विभाज्य होंगी या दोनों नहीं: ऐसी 0 संख्याएँ।

question: What is the largest power of 14 that divides 100!?
solution: 14 = 2 × 7, and 7s are far scarcer than 2s. Factors of 7 in 100!: 100 ÷ 7 gives 14 and 100 ÷ 49 gives 2: 16. So 14¹⁶.

question: What is the smallest number that has exactly three different prime factors and is divisible by 8?
solution: It must contain 2³ and two other primes, as small as possible: 3 and 5. 2³ × 3 × 5 = 120. (60 = 2² × 3 × 5 is not divisible by 8, and 168 = 2³ × 3 × 7 is larger.)

subject: Maths
question: Which of 46,926, 51,867, 63,945 and 72,288 is divisible by 99?
solution: Test for 99: split into pairs of digits from the right and add. 46,926 → 4 + 69 + 26 = 99, divisible (46,926 = 99 × 474). 51,867 → 5 + 18 + 67 = 90, 63,945 → 6 + 39 + 45 = 90, 72,288 → 7 + 22 + 88 = 117: not multiples of 99.

question: What is the smallest number of the form 2ⁿ − 1 (1, 3, 7, 15, ...) that is divisible by 23?
solution: Powers of 2 on division by 23 leave 2, 4, 8, 16, 9, 18, 13, 3, 6, 12, 1 - first 1 at n = 11. So 2¹¹ − 1 = 2,047 = 23 × 89 is the first.
questionHi: 2ⁿ − 1 (1, 3, 7, 15, ...) के रूप की वह सबसे छोटी संख्या कौन-सी है जो 23 से विभाज्य हो?

subject: Maths
question: Which of the following does NOT divide 7⁵⁰ − 1?
solution: 7⁵⁰ − 1 = 49²⁵ − 1 is divisible by 49 − 1 = 48, so by 6 and 8 too. On division by 5, 7² = 49 leaves 4, so 49²⁵ leaves 4²⁵, which leaves 4 (odd power of 4); 7⁵⁰ − 1 leaves 3. So 5 does not divide it.
questionHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन 7⁵⁰ − 1 को विभाजित नहीं करता?
solutionHi: 7⁵⁰ − 1 = 49²⁵ − 1, 49 − 1 = 48 से विभाज्य, अतः 6 और 8 से भी। 5 से भाग पर 7² = 49 का शेष 4, अतः 49²⁵ का शेष 4²⁵ जैसा, जो 4 है (4 की विषम घात); 7⁵⁰ − 1 का शेष 3। अतः 5 विभाजित नहीं करता।

subject: Maths
question: How many five-digit numbers with all digits odd are divisible by 25?
solution: A multiple of 25 ends in 00, 25, 50 or 75; with only odd digits it must end in 75. The first three digits can each be any of the 5 odd digits: 5³ = 125.
questionHi: सभी अंक विषम वाली पाँच अंकों की कितनी संख्याएँ 25 से विभाज्य हैं?
solutionHi: 25 का गुणज 00, 25, 50 या 75 पर समाप्त होता है; केवल विषम अंकों से 75 पर ही। पहले तीन अंक 5 विषम अंकों में से कोई भी: 5³ = 125।

subject: Maths
question: The smallest number written only with the digits 4 and 0 that is divisible by 18 has what digit sum?
solution: For 2 it must end in 0. For 9 its digit sum, 4 × (number of 4s), must be a multiple of 9, so it needs nine 4s. The smallest is 4,444,444,440, with digit sum 9 × 4 = 36.
questionHi: केवल अंकों 4 और 0 से लिखी, 18 से विभाज्य सबसे छोटी संख्या के अंकों का योग क्या है?

question: For how many natural numbers n from 1 to 100 is n(n + 1)(n + 2) divisible by 8?
solution: If n is even, n and n + 2 are consecutive even numbers, one a multiple of 4, so the product has 8: 50 values. If n is odd, only n + 1 is even and must itself be a multiple of 8: n = 7, 15, ..., 95, which is 12 values. 50 + 12 = 62.

question: Which of the following is NOT divisible by 6 for every natural number n?
solution: n² + n = n(n + 1) is only sure to be even: n = 1 gives 2. The other three are always multiples of 6: n³ − n and n(n + 1)(n + 2) are products of three consecutive numbers, and n³ + 5n = (n³ − n) + 6n.

question: What is the largest number that always divides 1 more than the sum of the squares of any three consecutive odd numbers?
solution: (2k − 1)² + (2k + 1)² + (2k + 3)² + 1 = 12k² + 12k + 12 = 12(k² + k + 1). k² + k + 1 is always odd, so no extra 2 is forced. k = 1 gives 1 + 9 + 25 + 1 = 36 and k = 2 gives 9 + 25 + 49 + 1 = 84, whose HCF is 12.
